latest_news.text: Reuters reports Trump saying a “great” Iran settlement would trigger opening of the Strait of Hormuz while shipping disruption persists.

latest_news.text: IAEA board resolution demands Iran declare enriched uranium stocks and admit inspectors after verification gaps at attacked sites.

latest_news.text: Reuters reports Christians fleeing Tyre amid concern Israel’s campaign will prevent return; regional reporting says latest Israeli strikes killed 13.

latest_news.text: Reuters reports Israeli fire killed three in Gaza amid a new ceasefire push; negotiations continue but violence has not paused.

latest_news.text: IAEA-linked reports say Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost all off-site power for the 19th time; Chornobyl repairs remain active after recent damage.

latest_news.text: Reuters/RSS report Taiwan rejecting Chinese patrol pressure and firing US-supplied HIMARS in coastal drills while China pressure continues.

latest_news.headline: Kim backs Russia; no fresh launch
